title: Topological sort with cycle detection
prompt: Write a function topological_sort(nodes, edges) where nodes is a list of hashable node ids and edges is a list of (before, after) pairs meaning 'before must appear before after'. Return a list containing every node in a valid topological order. Nodes with no edges are still included. Raise ValueError if the graph contains a cycle, or if an edge references a node that is not in nodes.
